title: Analytical calibration and traceable comparison
statement: Calibration is the complete traceable comparison of held reference input/response pairs with a sample response inside an explicit finite method domain, retaining uncertainty and every row.
generation_rule: Generate the literal product of the eight registered binary coordinates; decide every form by complete distinction preservation, exact recurrence/equivalence enumeration, minimality and absence of an extra rule.
grammar_boundary: Every finite registered reference-response set and sample response sharing one declared observation organization.

choices.name: traceable-reference-input
choices.reason: Reference identity and provenance are held.

choices.name: reference-response-pair-held
choices.reason: Each input retains its observed response.

choices.name: unordered-fit
choices.reason: A fit can conceal incompatible rows.

choices.name: sample-compared-with-reference-map
choices.reason: The same response organization is used.

choices.name: universal-unbounded-map
choices.reason: Calibration support is finite and method-bound.

choices.name: reference-map-and-result-trace
choices.reason: Inputs, responses and comparison are retained.

choices.name: free-calibration-parameter
choices.reason: A fitted value can select the answer.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: The complete registered comparison fixes the result.

induction_base: One traceable reference-response pair and one sample response supply the first comparison.
induction_step: Appending a reference pair preserves every earlier comparison and extends the declared calibration support.
exclusions: no analytical glossary, calibration curve, spectral database, measured line, fitted profile, target source or V2 answer may select a candidate
no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
no free, fitted, learned or target-derived parameter
no sample, component, response, transition, reference or unfavorable observation may be created, copied or silently erased
absence is an Empty structural form rather than numerical zero
external target content remains inaccessible until the prediction is sealed
Every finite registered reference-response set and sample response sharing one declared observation organization.

target_rows.source_locator: authority source set anchored at C00775

falsification_condition: The claim fails if authority evidence lacks response/reference relation, traceability, domain or uncertainty/method boundary, or if a tampered row is accepted.
